name: ai-knowledge-hub
description: Multi-company AI Research and Knowledge Hub with Sarvam AI chat and TTS.

scripts.dev: concurrently "python -m uvicorn server_py.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5000" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.install:all: python -m pip install -r server_py/requirements.txt && npm install --prefix client
